## Overview

This [[adyen]] **Apple Pay for iOS** page is an integration chooser. It routes readers to Apple Pay **iOS Drop-in** or an **iOS Component**, with separate links to general iOS Drop-in and Components integration material. Its short link descriptions do not establish child-guide prerequisites, certificates, SDK versions, current eligibility, or payment outcomes. [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- **Drop-in route:** The page links `/payment-methods/apple-pay/ios-drop-in` and calls it an all-in-one UI solution for adding Apple Pay to an iOS app. See raw lines 19–23.
- **Components route:** It links `/payment-methods/apple-pay/ios-component` and describes a pre-built Component to render Apple Pay on an iOS app. See raw lines 25–27.
- **General background:** The page also links general iOS Drop-in and Components Sessions-flow documentation. These links are navigation, not proof that the child Apple Pay guides share every requirement or behavior. See raw line 29.
